Своё оформление Kadro\n=================:
Your own Kadro look
===================

There are two files here that change how the app looks:

  custom.css  — any styles (CSS), like for a website.
  theme.json  — colors and sizes only: look variables for the dark, light or both (all) themes.

How to turn it on: Kadro → “Settings” (the gear on the Home screen or at the top) → “Your own look” → turn on.
Changes apply as soon as you save the file — no need to restart the app.

If something broke and you can't see the interface — turn the switch off or rename custom.css and theme.json.

Main variables (theme.json):
  --bg          window background     --panel      panel background
  --raised      buttons and tiles     --raised-2   the same, lighter
  --line        lines and borders     --line-soft  thin lines
  --text        main text             --muted      secondary text
  --accent      accent color (buttons, playhead, selection)
  --on-accent   text color on an accent button
  --accent-soft translucent highlight of the selection
  --video, --overlay, --audio, --textclip, --caption  — clip colors on the timeline
  --radius-s, --radius-m  — corner radius
  --font        interface font

Example theme.json — teal accent and bluish panels in the dark theme:
  {
    "dark": { "--accent": "#00d1c1", "--panel": "#121a24", "--bg": "#0c1118" },
    "all":  { "--radius-m": "14px" }
  }

Element classes are easy to inspect in the developer tools: F12 in the Kadro window.
Full instructions with examples: https://github.com/honeyjostar/kadro/blob/master/docs/CUSTOMIZE.md
